name: Mirivo
subtitle: Screen sharing & IPTV
promotionalText: Your sources, together. CarPlay audio controls, personal media sharing, vehicle mode with large controls and on-device live captions. Always ad-free
description:
Mirivo brings your media sources together with iPhone playback, personal media sharing and CarPlay audio controls.

• M3U playlists, direct streams and Xtream Codes servers
• Search channels and groups
• Source selection and Now Playing audio controls in CarPlay
• Vehicle mode with large controls
• Screen and app-audio sharing through the iOS system broadcast control
• On-device live captions on supported devices and languages
• Interface in 22 languages with in-app language selection
• Local connection logs and optional diagnostic reports

Mirivo contains no ads. The free tier includes 2 hours of daily viewing, 1 saved source and 10 minutes per broadcast. Mirivo Pro unlocks unlimited viewing, sources and broadcasting, vehicle mode and supported live captions. The yearly subscription auto-renews and is billed once per year. Lifetime is a one-time purchase. Prices are shown in the app. Manage subscriptions in your Apple account.

Mirivo does not provide channels, IPTV accounts or content subscriptions. Use sources you have permission to access. This version uses CarPlay Audio and does not provide video or screen mirroring in CarPlay. In-car screen broadcasting requires a separate CarPlay Video-enabled version and a compatible connection. Purchasing Pro does not grant that entitlement. Live captions require iOS 26 and a supported device and language. Some apps and protected content may not permit screen capture.

Source URLs and credentials stay in your device’s Keychain. Screen content, audio and captions are not uploaded to a developer server.

Support: https://mirivo-support.netlify.app/en/support.html
